purpose: Retain reusable knowledge instead of keeping every raw workflow experience forever.

layers.purpose: Short-lived operational material such as active feeds, current story drafts, dossiers, editor reviews, image prompts, and pending patches.
layers.retentionRule: Keep while active; distill lessons and compact after publication, abandonment, or learning extraction.

layers.purpose: Compressed lessons from events, rejections, repairs, source failures, and publication outcomes.
layers.retentionRule: Store what happened, why it mattered, and what changed; avoid retaining full article text unless needed for visible publication or audit.

layers.purpose: Generalized topic, writing, evidence, source, and editorial knowledge that improves future behavior.
layers.retentionRule: Promote repeated successful lessons into compact rules with confidence and usage evidence.

layers.purpose: Reusable statistical observations such as first-pass approval patterns, headline failures, image fit, and source reliability trends.
layers.retentionRule: Store pattern, confidence, evidence count, use-when, and avoid-when. Do not store raw article text as the pattern.

layers.purpose: Only significant decisions, failures, breakthroughs, and owner-approved capability changes.
layers.retentionRule: Store decision, reason, outcome, improvement, and future confidence; discard ordinary raw experience after distillation gates pass.

layers.purpose: Reusable operational procedures such as source isolation, headline repair, reject-repair-resubmit, payload visibility checks, and memory compaction.
layers.retentionRule: Keep as named capabilities only while verification evidence shows they still work.

layers.purpose: Owner intent, editorial boundaries, legal policy, brand standards, architecture rules, and governance expectations.
layers.retentionRule: Never delete through cleanup; update only through explicit owner or framework-approved change.

deletionPolicy.reason: First pass classifies and distills only. Raw deletion/compaction requires proven public visibility and learning preservation.
deletionPolicy.futureGate: A raw item can be deleted only after it is not active, not public-facing, not needed for audit, and its reusable lesson has been written to semantic, skill, pattern, or experience memory.
